Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event

package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event
Server-side Forge events, posted on MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS. Listen with @SubscribeEvent like any other Forge event.

Side: logical server. Threads: each event documents the thread it is posted on. MicrophonePacketEvent runs on a network thread; the others run on the server thread.

Since:
1.1.0
